requirements.text: Accept exactly one existing direct-child execution-plans target and fail before any state, log, model, or production write when containment, identity, required contract, or lifecycle validation fails.
Coordinate Bootstrap upstream-plan review through the repository-owned Skill, consume its native confidence and finalized evidence, and route plan repairs only through VDD.
Require plan-ready plus explicit target-bound maintainer authorization before Quick Dev starts; Bootstrap clean or assistant text alone cannot publish implementation-authorized.
Invoke Quick Dev TDD only through its strict plan-directory route and continue until its plan-local terminal predicate publishes implementation-complete or a typed stop is reached.

Invoke Refactor Acceptance as the acceptance owner and follow its deterministic, Bootstrap, focused-repair, Quick Dev repair, and manual-pause routes until acceptance-passed or a typed stop is reached.
Recompute one typed next action from current owner evidence before every expensive action and never infer completion from prose, stale checkpoint data, or process names.

Persist a compact non-authorizing checkpoint under logs so a compacted or later Codex session can quickly recover target identity, current owner, last completed action, blockers, evidence refs, and next action.

Do not create a timer, scheduled task, service, three-minute poller, detached Codex launcher, or process-name based Skill detector; controlled recovery is driven by the explicit coordinator post-run hook and owner inspection.

Automatically continue only within already granted ordinary write authority and retain explicit per-boundary acknowledgement for high-cost launch, later finding-mode re-entry, protected paths, and manual-pause closure.
Preserve child lifecycle ownership, bounded Bootstrap lineage, transport retry semantics, P2 current-run closure, append-only evidence, and historical failures.
Package the coordinator as a concise repository-local Skill with SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml, only necessary scripts/references/schemas/tests, and no auxiliary README or machine-specific path.

Provide detached positive and negative composition fixtures covering invalid targets, active and stale child attempts, context compaction, plan repair, implementation completion, acceptance repair, confirmation stops, and acceptance-passed.
Keep Phase service, runtime, live workspaces, auth, shared LLM entrypoints, the three child Skill packages, and their historical run evidence outside the implementation write set.
Require an Accepted ADR before enabling the opt-in coordinator because the current design input rejects a unified automatic Toolchain Harness entry.

Define one explicit project-local post-run hook owned only by the coordinator; invoke it for controlled completion, controlled failure, timeout, or reported poll-stop, but suppress it for user-stop and manual-pause and never attach it to a child Skill.
Run the coordinator as a filesystem-backed five-stage loop of recover, plan, execute, verify, and iterate, with durable checkpoints before and after dispatch and no model-context authority.
When a hook requests recovery, use an explicit project-local fresh-session launcher that consumes structured state and does not assume a global /new command or inherit conversational state.

Require coordinator-owned tool calls and state transitions to be idempotent and replayable, with journaled or owner-declared rollback boundaries and no early convergence before typed terminal predicates and closure evidence.

acceptance.assertion: A deterministic CLI accepts one canonical direct child of execution-plans and records its resolved repository-relative identity.
Missing, file, root, nested, traversal, reparse/symlink escape, ambiguous, schema-invalid, or lifecycle-invalid targets fail with zero checkpoint, log, model, or target writes.

The initial review action selects bootstrap-upstream-plan and uses inspect-lineage, preflight, access proof, launch authorization, gate, verification, closure, and finalized-run validation from the Bootstrap owner.
Each finding retains Bootstrap confidence and disposition; P0/P1 plan repair routes to VDD as one batch and P2 follows current-run closure without an unbounded semantic loop.
A fixture proves Bootstrap clean without explicit target-bound maintainer authorization cannot start Quick Dev or publish implementation-authorized.
Quick Dev is entered only for a strict schema-valid implementation contract in implementation-authorized state and publishes at most implementation-complete.
Repeated implementation failures follow Quick Dev fingerprint stop-loss and repair handoff rules rather than blind reruns.
Acceptance is entered only after implementation-complete and remains the sole publisher of acceptance-passed.
Acceptance-required Bootstrap and repair actions preserve the stable target-derived lineage, bounded round budget, exact repair completeness, and typed manual pauses.
Every dispatch is preceded by a fresh owner inspection; stale checkpoints and process-name observations cannot select or authorize an action.
A fresh session can reconstruct a concise status and next action from the target plan, owner evidence, and a hash-verified non-authorizing checkpoint without conversation history.
Static and runtime tests reject background polling, scheduled-task/service installation, detached Codex launch, and process-name based Skill liveness checks.

Fixtures stop before unknown high-cost acknowledgement, later discovery confirmation, protected-path approval, and manual-pause acknowledgement; a standing prompt cannot silently satisfy an estimate- or trigger-bound gate.
The coordinator carries authorizes empty and cannot alter child evidence, reset Bootstrap lineage, convert transport failures into semantic rounds, or treat assistant text as completion.
Skill package validation and UI metadata validation pass with no README, placeholder file, user-profile path, or unneeded resource directory.
Detached fixture and forward-test matrices cover every declared route and recovery family without launching live high-cost reviewers or touching live Phase state.
Candidate and command manifests contain no child Skill, Phase, runtime, auth, hosted workspace, shared LLM entrypoint, or historical evidence write path.
ADR-0059 is Accepted, indexed, and explicitly distinguishes this opt-in same-session coordinator from a repository-global Harness or lifecycle owner.

A deterministic stop matrix triggers the coordinator hook for controlled completion, controlled failure, timeout, and reported poll-stop, while suppressing it for user-stop and manual-pause and proving no child Skill has the hook.
The project-local hook reads only schema-valid filesystem events, current projection, owner evidence, and hash-bound checkpoints; its result is append-only and idempotent for a run/stop epoch.
The hook has no hidden global installation, detached controller, process-name liveness check, or lifecycle publication authority.
A fixture replays recover, plan, execute, verify, and iterate transitions with a persisted event and checkpoint after every stage and reconstructs the same state without conversation history.
Every next action is selected from typed validator predicates and current owner evidence; prose, confidence invented by the coordinator, and model context cannot route an action.
The loop does not converge on an intermediate success: terminal predicates, declared closure, and acceptance ownership are required before exit.
A hook recovery fixture invokes an explicit project-local fresh-session launcher with structured input and proves no dependency on a global /new command or old conversational context.
Coordinator dispatches carry stable idempotency keys, persist intent before mutation, preserve historical evidence, and either journal rollback or consume an owner-declared non-rollback boundary.
A replay fixture proves a failed or repeated iteration is repaired from filesystem evidence rather than blindly rerun or accepted as converged.
